The '''Ruined City''' was an old remnant of [[Voss]] civilization. Located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] in the [[Old Paths]], the site was home to many [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] troops and excavation teams. The entrance to the [[Halls of Enlightenment]] was also located in the area.
